assertion_results.text: Impact map or task descriptions explicitly flag at least 3 ambiguities from the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: The impact-map.md contains a dedicated '## Ambiguities and Gaps' section that explicitly flags 5 ambiguities: (1) 'Search should be faster' — no performance baseline or target, (2) 'Results should be more relevant' — no definition of relevance or ranking criteria, (3) 'Add filters' — no specification of filter types/fields/behavior, (4) 'Should be fast enough' — non-functional requirement with no measurable target, (5) 'Don't break existing functionality' — implicit with no regression test strategy defined. All 5 exceed the minimum of 3.

assertion_results.text: Plan acknowledges that 'Better UI' (non-MVP) cannot be planned without design mockups or frontend repository and excludes it from scope
assertion_results.evidence: The impact-map.md contains an '## Excluded Requirements' section stating: '"Better UI" (non-MVP): This requirement cannot be planned. No frontend repository is available in the Repository Registry (only trustify-backend), no Figma design mockups are provided, and no design specifications exist to decompose into actionable tasks. This requirement is excluded from the plan scope entirely.' The summary-comment.md also confirms: '"Better UI" (non-MVP): excluded — no frontend repository available, no design mockups provided.'

assertion_results.text: Tasks still follow the task-description-template.md format despite ambiguous requirements
assertion_results.evidence: All 4 task files follow the template format. Each contains: ## Repository (trustify-backend), ## Target Branch (main), ## Description, ## Files to Modify or ## Files to Create, ## Implementation Notes, ## Acceptance Criteria (with checkbox items), ## Test Requirements (with checkbox items), ## Dependencies. Task 3 also includes ## Reuse Candidates. The structure matches task-description-template.md exactly.

assertion_results.text: Tasks document assumptions where they fill in missing details, labeled as assumptions pending clarification
assertion_results.evidence: Each task explicitly labels assumptions: task-1 Description: 'Assumption pending clarification: The feature description states search is "currently too slow" but provides no performance baseline or target latency.' task-2 Description: 'Assumption pending clarification: The feature description states users complain about "irrelevant results" but provides no definition of relevance...' task-3 Description: 'Assumption pending clarification: The feature description does not specify which fields should be filterable...' Task-1 Implementation Notes also contains: 'assumption pending clarification — no language requirements specified'. All assumptions use the exact label 'Assumption pending clarification' or 'assumption pending clarification'.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains a Repository section with a single repository name (not multiple repos per task)
assertion_results.evidence: All 4 task files contain '## Repository' followed by 'trustify-backend' as a single repository name: task-1 line 2, task-2 line 2, task-3 line 2, task-4 line 2. No task lists multiple repositories.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements sections as required by the handoff contract in task-description-template.md
assertion_results.evidence: All 4 tasks contain: ## Target Branch (set to 'main'), ## Description (detailed descriptions present), ## Acceptance Criteria (with checkbox items), ## Test Requirements (with checkbox items). Verified in task-1 through task-4.

assertion_results.text: File paths in Files to Modify and Files to Create reference paths from the repo-backend.md mock repository structure manifest, not invented paths
assertion_results.evidence: Task-1 Files to Create: 'migration/src/m0002_search_indexes/mod.rs' — new file in existing migration/src/ directory (parent exists in repo manifest). Task-1 Files to Modify: 'migration/src/lib.rs' — exists in manifest. Task-2: 'modules/search/src/service/mod.rs' and 'modules/search/src/endpoints/mod.rs' — both exist in manifest. Task-3: same two plus 'common/src/db/query.rs' — all exist in manifest. Task-4: 'tests/api/search.rs' — exists in manifest. All paths are consistent with repo-backend.md directory tree.

assertion_results.text: Implementation Notes in every task reference specific file paths and code patterns from the repository, not abstract or generic guidance
assertion_results.evidence: Task-1: references 'migration/src/m0001_initial/mod.rs' for pattern, mentions SeaORM migration trait. Task-2: references 'modules/search/src/service/mod.rs' (SearchService), 'modules/search/src/endpoints/mod.rs' (GET /api/v2/search), 'common/src/model/paginated.rs' (PaginatedResults<T>), 'modules/fundamental/src/sbom/service/sbom.rs' (error handling pattern). Task-3: references 'common/src/db/query.rs' (query builder helpers), 'modules/fundamental/src/sbom/endpoints/list.rs' and 'modules/fundamental/src/advisory/endpoints/list.rs' (established filter pattern), 'common/src/model/paginated.rs'. Task-4: references 'tests/api/search.rs', 'tests/api/sbom.rs', 'tests/api/advisory.rs' (existing test patterns). All notes include specific file paths and symbol names.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains a Target Branch section set to 'main'
assertion_results.evidence: All 4 tasks contain '## Target Branch' followed by 'main': task-1 line 4, task-2 line 4, task-3 line 4, task-4 line 4.

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: None of the 4 task files contain the prescribed 'Applies:' rationale format for convention applicability. The tasks reference docs/constraints.md sections (e.g., task-1: 'Per docs/constraints.md §5 (Code Change Rules)') but do not reference CONVENTIONS.md conventions with applicability rationale. The repo-backend.md indicates a CONVENTIONS.md file exists at the repository root, but no task includes convention references with the prescribed 'Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>' format. Convention-aware enrichment with applicability validation is absent from all outputs.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: The feature TC-9002 has Priority: Normal. The impact-map.md contains: 'Priority: Normal — inherited from Feature TC-9002. Will be propagated to all created tasks.' The summary-comment.md contains: 'Priority: Normal — inherited from Feature TC-9002. Propagated to all 4 created tasks via additional_fields: { "priority": {"name": "Normal"} }.' Priority inheritance is clearly documented.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: The feature TC-9002 has fixVersions: RHTPA 1.6.0. The impact-map.md contains: 'fixVersions: RHTPA 1.6.0 — inherited from Feature TC-9002. Will be propagated to all created tasks (fixVersion scope defaults to both per Jira Field Defaults).' The summary-comment.md contains: 'fixVersions: RHTPA 1.6.0 — inherited from Feature TC-9002. Propagated to all 4 created tasks via additional_fields: { "fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.6.0"}] }. The fixVersion scope in Jira Field Defaults is absent, defaulting to both, so fixVersions are propagated to tasks.' Both fixVersion inheritance and scope reasoning are documented.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: A summary-comment.md file exists in the outputs directory. It includes an '## Inherited Field Propagation' section with both priority ('Normal' propagated) and fixVersions ('RHTPA 1.6.0' propagated) values documented with their propagation details. Additionally, the impact-map.md contains its own '## Inherited Field Propagation' section with the same information.

assertion_results.text: No documentation task is generated because the feature description does not contain a Documentation Considerations section
assertion_results.evidence: The feature-ambiguous.md fixture contains no 'Documentation Considerations' section — the document ends after Non-Functional Requirements. The outputs directory contains only 4 task files: task-1-add-fulltext-search-indexes.md, task-2-improve-search-relevance.md, task-3-add-search-filter-parameters.md, task-4-search-integration-tests.md. None of these is a documentation task. No documentation task was generated.

assertion_results.text: No testing tasks are generated because no testing readiness template is present in the eval fixture files
assertion_results.evidence: The eval case 2 fixture files list only 'files/feature-ambiguous.md' and 'files/repo-backend.md' — no testing-readiness.md is included. The outputs directory contains 4 task files, none of which is a cross-cutting testing task (all are implementation or integration test tasks). Task 4 is an integration test task within the normal plan scope, not a cross-cutting testing task generated from a readiness template. No testing readiness template-derived tasks were generated.
